items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: when I was with Sun Ra and Archie Shepp and Cecil Taylor. All these people, when I was playing with those people I played that style

ctx.x: you would have to try to describe it yourself and what would you use as adjectives and terms to describe your creativity?

Yes I’ve been asked that question and I basically say my music has no real category in the sense — I can play free music or avant garde music and I can play spirituals, I can play blues. I consider myself — if you thought of someone that was a linguistic, a linguist — I can speak seven or eight or nine languages. I can speak gospel, I can speak blues, I can speak rhythm & blues, I can speak rock, I can speak avant garde, I can speak straight ahead. You know. Any kind of category of music I fit.
